title: Radix
description: What Radix, the collector, does: requests to b-tu.de and QIS by endpoint, what changed, its cycles and the snapshots it publishes. From GET /metrics of each instance's Radix (job radix). Provisioned from deploy/config/monitoring/grafana/dashboards - edit there.

list.name: Snapshot published
list.textFormat: A new catalog snapshot was exported for the web server.

list.name: stack
list.label: Instance
list.description: The instances whose Radix is scraped. Only one instance of a site crawls; the others serve their snapshot offline.

panels.title: Health
panels.description: GET /healthz of each instance's Radix: unhealthy without a snapshot to serve, after two failed cycles in a row, or without a successful cycle for 26 h. Only an instance that crawls (mode run) reports it; an offline one shows its snapshot below.

panels.title: Mode
panels.description: run: crawls the university and builds the catalog. serve-snapshot: offline (RADIX_CRAWL=off), only serves the snapshot it has. Exactly one instance of a site should crawl.

panels.title: Last successful cycle
panels.description: Time since the last cycle that ended ok or degraded. A cycle starts every 30 min; above 26 h /healthz turns unhealthy.

panels.title: Failed cycles in a row
panels.description: Cycles whose build, validation or export failed since the last good one; the previous snapshot stays current. 2 or more = unhealthy.

panels.title: Now
panels.description: Whether a cycle is running right now; otherwise when the next one starts.

panels.title: Off-peak window
panels.description: Between 01:00 and 06:00 local time the bulk stages crawl (module index, module pages, QIS descriptions, tree). By day only the event search and the event pages it has news for.

panels.title: Requests to the university
panels.description: HTTP requests Radix sent to b-tu.de / QIS in the selected time range, retries included.

panels.title: Failed requests
panels.description: Requests without a 200 or 404 answer (timeouts, 5xx, …) in the selected range. Each is retried twice; a page given up is an ERROR in the log.

panels.title: Pages changed, 24 h
panels.description: Archived pages whose content changed (or that are new) in the last 24 hours, read from the archive itself: survives restarts.

panels.title: Snapshots published
panels.description: New catalog snapshots exported for the web server in the selected range. Only when the content changed.

panels.title: Current snapshot
panels.description: Age of the snapshot each instance offers the web server. It only gets newer when the catalog's content changed, so a day or two is normal.

panels.title: Errors in the log
panels.description: Log records at level ERROR in the selected range (a human is needed; alert "betula: ERROR in the logs"). The events are listed below.

panels.title: Requests to the university, by endpoint
Requests by endpoint
panels.description: HTTP requests sent per endpoint, retries included, per bar.

panels.title: Requests per endpoint, selected range
panels.description: All requests of the selected range per endpoint.

panels.title: Answers by status code
panels.description: What the university answered. 200 and 404 are final answers; everything else (5xx, "error" = no answer at all) is retried after 30 s and 60 s.

panels.title: Response time p95 by endpoint
panels.description: 95th percentile of the time from request to the end of the body. Above 15 s a request is logged as crawl.slow.

panels.title: Data received by endpoint
panels.description: Bytes of response bodies per bar.

panels.title: Pages by outcome
panels.description: What became of every page fetched: changed (new, or another content than the archived one), unchanged, not_found (404), failed (given up after three attempts). The event search counts each event it lists.

panels.title: Changed pages by endpoint
panels.description: Pages whose content changed (or that are new), per endpoint and bar.

panels.title: The archive, by endpoint
panels.description: What the raw page archive holds per endpoint, read from the database (once a minute): pages, pages the server answers with 404, pages fetched and changed in the last 24 hours, and how long ago the newest and the oldest fetch were. Module pages are read weekly, QIS descriptions, the tree and event pages monthly: an oldest fetch beyond about 31 days means a stage falls behind.

panels.title: Catalog builds
panels.description: Every cycle builds the catalog from the archive. changed: the published content differs, so a snapshot is validated and exported; unchanged: nothing to publish. Module rows changed: rows of the QIS module table that read differently, whose descriptions are fetched again.

panels.title: What the catalog holds
panels.description: Counts of the last build. A sudden drop usually means a page layout changed and a parser no longer recognises it (validation would then refuse to publish).

panels.title: Removed by retention
panels.description: Events past their last date (after 30 days) and archived pages nothing leads to any more (after 7 days).

panels.title: Cycles by result
panels.description: ok: everything ran. degraded: a crawl stage failed, the published data is intact but may age. failed: build, validation or export failed, the previous snapshot stays. interrupted: stopped (deploy).

panels.title: Stage duration
panels.description: How long the last run of each stage took. The crawl stages are long in the off-peak window, the build takes about 20 s.

panels.title: Stages that failed or were skipped
panels.description: failed: the stage logged stage.failed (ERROR). skipped: a bulk stage outside the off-peak window, or the export when the content did not change - both normal.

panels.title: Cycle running
panels.description: When Radix was working.

panels.title: Memory and CPU of Radix
panels.description: The container of each instance's Radix (limits: 1 GB, 1 CPU). The build is the big consumer.

panels.title: Snapshot requests from the web server
panels.description: Folia asks every minute whether there is a new snapshot: 304 = it has it already, 200 on catalog.db = a download (after a new export or a restart), 503 = no snapshot yet.

panels.title: Warnings and errors by event
panels.description: Log records at WARN and ERROR per event name (docs/operations.md, section 2). Retries, slow answers and 404s are WARN; given-up pages, failed stages and failed checks are ERROR.

panels.title: Radix log: warnings and errors
panels.description: The newest WARN and ERROR lines of Radix. Everything else: dashboard Logs, service <stack>_radix.
